correctness.rationale: Given the shared Riccati x-flow and polynomial-affine y-flow (L>=1,N>=L+2), x_i-x_j satisfies (B+C(x_i+x_j))(x_i-x_j); barycentric weights over |S|=L+2 obey dlogw_i/dt=-(L+1)B-C(Lx_i+sum_S x). Because the (L+1)-st divided difference of every polynomial of degree <=L vanishes, dΔ_S/dt=(D-(L+1)B-C sum_S x)Δ_S. The difference law cancels in all K_i, and the Δ ratio multiplier cancels in the normalized J_i. Conversely matching 3 x coordinates determines a pole-free positive-denominator Möbius transform, matching x order and all K forces all x; sign(Δ0) fixes positive lambda, and interpolating Q at L+1 nodes with Δ constraints reconstructs all y. The rational coordinate inverse proves independence of N-3 plus N-L-2 integrals = 2N-L-5. I independently checked exact rational Möbius/divided-difference covariance and differential-identity examples without relying on saved verifier logs. This covers finite regular flow portions only, not singular strata.
residual_risks: N=L+2 endpoint has no J_i; sign and distinctness essential; finite-pole crossings excluded.
